resources.string: Watches only the YouTube and Instagram apps to detect the Shorts or Reels screen and press Back. It does not read, store or share any content.
Open source • No ads • No internet access
The rest of the app keeps working
Your selected apps are protected. Everything else works normally.
The service is running, but every blocker below is switched off.
Turn on Shorts Blocker in Accessibility settings to start blocking.
Feed, Stories and DMs keep working
A friendly nudge whenever a Short or Reel is blocked

Shorts Blocker uses Android\'s Accessibility Service to notice when the YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels screen is open, and then presses Back.\n\nIt only watches the YouTube and Instagram apps. It does not read, store or share your content, messages or personal data, and it has no internet access.

• Only watches the YouTube and Instagram apps, nothing else
• Never reads, stores or shares what you watch or type
• Has no internet permission, so it cannot send data anywhere
• The counters above are saved only on your phone
• The full source code is public so you can verify all of this
Android offers no other way for an app to know which screen YouTube or Instagram is showing. Shorts Blocker uses this permission only to notice the Shorts or Reels screen and press Back.
